title: 真实双API Server滚动换钥并验证etcd存量密文迁移
body:
## 环境与原始材料
平台隔离Linux工作区含kube-apiserver v1.34.1、etcd3.6.4、OpenSSL与Python标准库；固定检查器自建私有mTLS控制面，无网络下载，不读取或改动用户kubeconfig。双实例换钥需至少1536MiB工作区；其余单实例可用768MiB。

## 操作任务
实现 plan(old,new)，参数是两份随机有效 AES-CBC key 描述字典，返回有序阶段列表，每阶段含 config 完整 EncryptionConfiguration 及 rewrite 布尔值。固定验收器按阶段依次滚动两个真实 API Server，并在每个实例刚切换后写入随机 Secret、跨实例读取全部对象；rewrite=true 时通过 API GET/PUT 重写全部对象。必须先让所有实例识别新钥，再启用新写入，再重写存量，最后停用旧钥。最终两个实例均无旧钥且etcd实际存储全用新钥。不能把 API 明文可读当作换钥完成。

## 交付产物
solution.py；仅修改该文件，不修改checks。

## 验收方法
运行python3 checks/check.py，真实原生API/etcd多分支断言，参考/初始/错误/提前exit0四路线及独立对抗反例，错误方案必须失败。

## 能力边界
双真实API Server与同一etcd，验证配置兼容窗口、跨实例读写、原数据保持和底层密文前缀。未验证KMS、生产HA负载均衡、etcd快照恢复与备份密钥托管，原答案关于这些边界仍保留。
source: OpsForge 原创高级与项目题；依据官方机制编审
rubric: 依据题给约束推演而非复述术语
明确关键证据、作用边界与处理顺序
提出可判定的验证及失败处置
review_note: 困难方向原生试点；固定检查器实际启动隔离控制面验证机制，平台四路及独立反例的逐次结果、版本和源码哈希见配套运行报告，不把原生API试验等同生产全链验收。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

import base64
import importlib.util
import json
import pathlib
import secrets
import time
from native import Cluster


def load_student():
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('submission',pathlib.Path('solution.py').resolve())
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def role(cluster, ns, name, rules, user):
    cluster.create('/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/roles',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':name},'rules':rules})
    cluster.create('/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/rolebindings',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':name},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':name},'subjects':[{'kind':'User','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','name':user}]})


def encryption(keys):
    return {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'aescbc':{'keys':keys}},{'identity':{}}]}]}


def check_rotation():
    old={'name':'old-'+secrets.token_hex(4),'secret':base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode()}
    new={'name':'new-'+secrets.token_hex(4),'secret':base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode()}
    plan=load_student().plan(old.copy(),new.copy())
    assert isinstance(plan,list) and 1<=len(plan)<=5,'provide a bounded rotation plan'
    audit=[]
    with Cluster(encryption([old])) as primary:
        peer=primary.peer(encryption([old]))
        try:
            print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:rotation',flush=True)
            ns='rotation-'+secrets.token_hex(4);primary.namespace(ns)
            targets=[]
            for i in range(3):
                name='secret-'+secrets.token_hex(3);payload=base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(23)).decode()
                path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{name}'
                primary.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Secret','metadata':{'name':name},'data':{'payload':payload}})
                targets.append((name,path,payload))
            old_cipher=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{targets[0][0]}')
            assert old_cipher.startswith(('k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:'+old['name']+':').encode())
            for index,step in enumerate(plan):
                assert isinstance(step,dict) and type(step.get('rewrite')) is bool,'rewrite must be an explicit boolean'
                config=step['config']
                for server in (primary,peer):
                    server.restart_api(config)
                    # A writer changes as soon as this instance restarts. Every other
                    # instance must already understand what it writes.
                    name='probe-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
                    value=base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(17)).decode()
                    server.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Secret','metadata':{'name':name},'data':{'payload':value}})
                    targets.append((name,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{name}',value))
                    for reader in (primary,peer):
                        for _,path,payload in targets:
                            code,obj=reader.request('GET',path)
                            assert code==200 and obj['data']['payload']==payload,'cross-instance compatibility failed before/after a rolling update'
                if step.get('rewrite'):
                    for _,path,payload in targets:
                        code,obj=primary.request('GET',path);assert code==200
                        code,_=primary.request('PUT',path,obj);assert code==200
                prefixes=[]
                for name,_,_ in targets:
                    raw=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{name}')
                    assert b'k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:' in raw[:32],'plaintext provider cannot be preferred'
                    prefixes.append(raw.split(b':',5)[4].decode())
                audit.append({'phase':index,'objects':len(targets),'key_names':sorted(set(prefixes))})
            for name,path,payload in targets:
                raw=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{name}')
                assert raw.startswith(('k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:'+new['name']+':').encode()),'existing storage was not actually rewritten with new key'
                for server in (primary,peer):
                    assert server.request('GET',path)[1]['data']['payload']==payload
            for server in (primary,peer):
                final=json.loads(server.encryption_path.read_text())
                serialized=json.dumps(final)
                assert old['secret'] not in serialized and old['name'] not in serialized,'old decryption key was not retired'
            print(json.dumps({'native':'etcd3.6.4+kube-apiserver1.34.1','instances':2,'rolling_cross_reads':True,'storage_rewritten':True,'old_cipher_bytes':len(old_cipher),'phases':audit}))
        finally:peer.close()


def check_rbac():
    target_name='release-editor-'+secrets.token_hex(5)
    target_user='opsforge-pilot-user-'+secrets.token_hex(5)
    desired=load_student().manifests(target_name,target_user)
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        cluster.identity('learner',target_user)
        ns='rbac-'+secrets.token_hex(4);cluster.namespace(ns)
        cluster.identity('manager','opsforge-pilot-manager');cluster.identity('outsider','opsforge-pilot-outsider')
        base=[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'resourceNames':['baseline'],'verbs':['get']}]
        edit=[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'resourceNames':['release'],'verbs':['get','patch','update']}]
        role(cluster,ns,'baseline-view',base,target_user)
        role(cluster,ns,'manager',edit+[{'apiGroups':['rbac.authorization.k8s.io'],'resources':['roles','rolebindings'],'verbs':['get','create']}],'opsforge-pilot-manager')
        for name in ('baseline','release','unrelated'):
            cluster.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':name},'data':{'value':secrets.token_hex(8)}})
        baseline=cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/baseline-view')[1]
        assert cluster.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps/baseline',identity='learner')[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:rbac',flush=True)
        assert isinstance(desired,list) and len(desired)==2
        for obj in desired:
            assert obj.get('kind') in ('Role','RoleBinding')
            obj['metadata']['namespace']=ns
            plural='roles' if obj['kind']=='Role' else 'rolebindings'
            code,result=cluster.request('POST',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/{plural}',obj,identity='manager')
            assert code==201,('delegation rejected by real bind/escalate guard',code,result)
        actual_role=cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/roles/{target_name}')
        actual_binding=cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/{target_name}')
        assert actual_role[0]==actual_binding[0]==200,'must use the supplied dynamic role and binding name'
        assert actual_binding[1]['roleRef']['name']==target_name
        probes=[]
        def expect(method,path,expected,data=None,identity='learner',ctype='application/json'):
            code,value=cluster.request(method,path,data,identity,ctype);probes.append({'method':method,'path':path,'identity':identity,'status':code})
            assert code==expected,(code,expected,value)
        root=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}'
        expect('GET',root+'/configmaps/baseline',200)
        expect('PATCH',root+'/configmaps/release',200,{'data':{'value':'changed'}},ctype='application/merge-patch+json')
        expect('PATCH',root+'/configmaps/baseline',403,{'data':{'value':'bad'}},ctype='application/merge-patch+json')
        expect('PATCH',root+'/configmaps/unrelated',403,{'data':{'value':'bad'}},ctype='application/merge-patch+json')
        expect('GET',root+'/configmaps',403)
        expect('GET',root+'/secrets',403)
        expect('GET',root+'/configmaps/release',403,identity='outsider')
        bad={'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':'escalated'},'rules':[{'apiGroups':['*'],'resources':['*'],'verbs':['*']}]}
        expect('POST',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/roles',403,bad,identity='manager')
        binding={'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':'bad-admin'},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'ClusterRole','name':'cluster-admin'},'subjects':[{'kind':'User','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','name':target_user}]}
        expect('POST',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings',403,binding,identity='manager')
        assert cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/baseline-view')[1]==baseline
        print(json.dumps({'native_rbac':probes,'baseline_unchanged':True}))


def check_node():
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        ns='node-'+secrets.token_hex(4);cluster.namespace(ns)
        own='node-'+secrets.token_hex(3);other='node-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
        cluster.identity('node','system:node:'+own,'system:nodes')
        for name in (own,other):cluster.create('/api/v1/nodes',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Node','metadata':{'name':name}})
        secrets_by_node={}
        for node in (own,other):
            secret='key-'+secrets.token_hex(4);secrets_by_node[node]=secret
            cluster.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Secret','metadata':{'name':secret},'stringData':{'value':secrets.token_hex(8)}})
            cluster.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/pods',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':'pod-'+node},'spec':{'nodeName':node,'containers':[{'name':'work','image':'invalid.local/never-pulled','volumeMounts':[{'name':'data','mountPath':'/data'}]}],'volumes':[{'name':'data','secret':{'secretName':secret}}]}})
        paths={'own_secret':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{secrets_by_node[own]}','other_secret':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{secrets_by_node[other]}','own_node':'/api/v1/nodes/'+own,'other_node':'/api/v1/nodes/'+other}
        trace=[]
        def request(method,path,data=None):
            code,obj=cluster.request(method,path,data,identity='node',content_type='application/merge-patch+json' if method=='PATCH' else 'application/json')
            trace.append({'method':method,'path':path,'status':code});return code,obj
        for _ in range(50):
            if cluster.request('GET',paths['own_secret'],identity='node')[0]==200:break
            time.sleep(.1)
        assert cluster.request('GET',paths['own_secret'],identity='node')[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:node',flush=True)
        results=load_student().probe(request,paths)
        assert results=={'own_secret':200,'other_secret':403,'own_label':200,'other_node':403,'protected_label':403},results
        expected=[('GET',paths['own_secret'],200),('GET',paths['other_secret'],403),('PATCH',paths['own_node'],200),('PATCH',paths['other_node'],403),('PATCH',paths['own_node'],403)]
        assert [(x['method'],x['path'],x['status']) for x in trace]==expected,'must make and report actual API requests, not fabricate expected statuses'
        own_state=cluster.request('GET',paths['own_node'])[1]
        assert own_state['metadata']['labels'].get('opsforge.example.com/probe')=='checked'
        assert 'node-restriction.kubernetes.io/trusted' not in own_state['metadata'].get('labels',{})
        assert 'opsforge.example.com/probe' not in cluster.request('GET',paths['other_node'])[1]['metadata'].get('labels',{})
        assert request('GET',paths['own_secret'])[0]==200,'original allowed access regressed'
        # RBAC is additive: a separately granted read can bypass the node authorizer's
        # lack of a grant. Verify the leak, then revoke only this dedicated test grant.
        role(cluster,ns,'temporary-leak',[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['secrets'],'verbs':['get']}],'system:node:'+own)
        assert request('GET',paths['other_secret'])[0]==200,'additive RBAC control not exercised'
        assert cluster.request('DELETE',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/temporary-leak',{})[0]==200
        assert request('GET',paths['other_secret'])[0]==403
        assert request('GET',paths['own_secret'])[0]==200
        print(json.dumps({'node_authorizer_and_restriction':trace,'additive_rbac_control':True,'baseline_retained':True}))


def check_dryrun():
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        ns='dryrun-'+secrets.token_hex(4);cluster.namespace(ns)
        role(cluster,ns,'preview',[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'verbs':['get','list','create']}],'opsforge-pilot-user')
        # Real CEL admission policy: no fake HTTP server or local YAML-only validation.
        policy='guard-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        cluster.create('/apis/admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1/validatingadmissionpolicies',{'apiVersion':'admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1','kind':'ValidatingAdmissionPolicy','metadata':{'name':policy},'spec':{'failurePolicy':'Fail','matchConstraints':{'resourceRules':[{'apiGroups':[''],'apiVersions':['v1'],'operations':['CREATE'],'resources':['configmaps']}]},'validations':[{'expression':"!has(object.data) || !('forbidden' in object.data)",'message':'forbidden data is not admitted'}]}})
        cluster.create('/apis/admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1/validatingadmissionpolicybindings',{'apiVersion':'admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1','kind':'ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding','metadata':{'name':policy},'spec':{'policyName':policy,'validationActions':['Deny'],'matchResources':{'namespaceSelector':{'matchLabels':{'kubernetes.io/metadata.name':ns}}}}})
        # Wait for actual admission cache readiness before calling the learner.
        for _ in range(60):
            code,_=cluster.request('POST',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps?dryRun=All',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'ready-probe'},'data':{'forbidden':'x'}})
            if code==422:break
            time.sleep(.1)

        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:dryrun',flush=True)
        trace=[]
        def request(method,path,data=None):
            code,obj=cluster.request(method,path,data,identity='learner');trace.append({'method':method,'path':path,'status':code});return code,obj
        good={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'good-'+secrets.token_hex(4)},'data':{'value':secrets.token_hex(9)}}

title: 实测节点凭据关联授权、受保护标签及叠加RBAC漏洞
body:
## 环境与原始材料
平台隔离Linux工作区含kube-apiserver v1.34.1、etcd3.6.4、OpenSSL与Python标准库；固定检查器自建私有mTLS控制面，无网络下载，不读取或改动用户kubeconfig。双实例换钥需至少1536MiB工作区；其余单实例可用768MiB。

## 操作任务
实现 probe(request,paths)。request(method,path,data=None) 实际使用 system:node:<nodeName>、system:nodes 的专用mTLS身份请求当前隔离API Server，返回(status,JSON)。paths 含 own_secret/other_secret/own_node/other_node。按顺序读取本节点关联Secret、另一节点关联Secret、PATCH本节点普通标签opsforge.example.com/probe=checked、同样PATCH另一节点、PATCH本节点受保护标签node-restriction.kubernetes.io/trusted=yes。返回own_secret/other_secret/own_label/other_node/protected_label的真实HTTP码，不可捏造结果；预期200/403/200/403/403。验收额外实际添加宽泛RBAC，证明授权叠加可使原本无关联Secret可读；再只撤销该测试绑定，原权限仍在。

## 交付产物
solution.py；仅修改该文件，不修改checks。

## 验收方法
运行python3 checks/check.py，真实原生API/etcd多分支断言，参考/初始/错误/提前exit0四路线及独立对抗反例，错误方案必须失败。

## 能力边界
真实Node Authorizer+NodeRestriction和证书身份；Pod与Node是实际API对象，未运行kubelet、工作负载、CNI、调度器，不证明泄露证书撤换或生产节点恢复。
answer:
```python
def probe(request, paths):
    result={}
    result["own_secret"]=request("GET",paths["own_secret"])[0]
    result["other_secret"]=request("GET",paths["other_secret"])[0]
    patch={"metadata":{"labels":{"opsforge.example.com/probe":"checked"}}}
    result["own_label"]=request("PATCH",paths["own_node"],patch)[0]
    result["other_node"]=request("PATCH",paths["other_node"],patch)[0]
    result["protected_label"]=request("PATCH",paths["own_node"],{"metadata":{"labels":{"node-restriction.kubernetes.io/trusted":"yes"}}})[0]
    return result
```

## 原题原理与边界
先核对kubelet使用的用户名和组是否符合节点授权器识别条件，认证身份不匹配时不能假定按Node规则限制。Node Authorizer根据与该节点工作负载的关系授予需要的读取和更新能力，NodeRestriction准入进一步限制节点修改对象及受保护标签的范围；两者作用阶段不同。检查是否还有宽泛RBAC绑定额外授权，累加的权限可能破坏预期隔离。用专门测试节点身份尝试访问本节点关联Secret、另一节点无关联Secret、修改其他节点及修改受保护调度标签，逐项保存允许/拒绝证据。平台可信隔离标签应使用受保护命名约定并由管理员维护，不能让节点自报安全等级；泄露后的证书撤换与已暴露数据处置仍需单独完成。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

import base64
import importlib.util
import json
import pathlib
import secrets
import time
from native import Cluster


def load_student():
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('submission',pathlib.Path('solution.py').resolve())
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def role(cluster, ns, name, rules, user):
    cluster.create('/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/roles',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':name},'rules':rules})
    cluster.create('/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/rolebindings',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':name},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':name},'subjects':[{'kind':'User','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','name':user}]})


def encryption(keys):
    return {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'aescbc':{'keys':keys}},{'identity':{}}]}]}


def check_rotation():
    old={'name':'old-'+secrets.token_hex(4),'secret':base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode()}
    new={'name':'new-'+secrets.token_hex(4),'secret':base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode()}
    plan=load_student().plan(old.copy(),new.copy())
    assert isinstance(plan,list) and 1<=len(plan)<=5,'provide a bounded rotation plan'
    audit=[]
    with Cluster(encryption([old])) as primary:
        peer=primary.peer(encryption([old]))
        try:
            print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:rotation',flush=True)
            ns='rotation-'+secrets.token_hex(4);primary.namespace(ns)
            targets=[]
            for i in range(3):
                name='secret-'+secrets.token_hex(3);payload=base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(23)).decode()
                path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{name}'
                primary.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Secret','metadata':{'name':name},'data':{'payload':payload}})
                targets.append((name,path,payload))
            old_cipher=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{targets[0][0]}')
            assert old_cipher.startswith(('k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:'+old['name']+':').encode())
            for index,step in enumerate(plan):
                assert isinstance(step,dict) and type(step.get('rewrite')) is bool,'rewrite must be an explicit boolean'
                config=step['config']
                for server in (primary,peer):
                    server.restart_api(config)
                    # A writer changes as soon as this instance restarts. Every other
                    # instance must already understand what it writes.
                    name='probe-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
                    value=base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(17)).decode()
                    server.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Secret','metadata':{'name':name},'data':{'payload':value}})
                    targets.append((name,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{name}',value))
                    for reader in (primary,peer):
                        for _,path,payload in targets:
                            code,obj=reader.request('GET',path)
                            assert code==200 and obj['data']['payload']==payload,'cross-instance compatibility failed before/after a rolling update'
                if step.get('rewrite'):
                    for _,path,payload in targets:
                        code,obj=primary.request('GET',path);assert code==200
                        code,_=primary.request('PUT',path,obj);assert code==200
                prefixes=[]
                for name,_,_ in targets:
                    raw=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{name}')
                    assert b'k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:' in raw[:32],'plaintext provider cannot be preferred'
                    prefixes.append(raw.split(b':',5)[4].decode())
                audit.append({'phase':index,'objects':len(targets),'key_names':sorted(set(prefixes))})
            for name,path,payload in targets:
                raw=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{name}')
                assert raw.startswith(('k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:'+new['name']+':').encode()),'existing storage was not actually rewritten with new key'
                for server in (primary,peer):
                    assert server.request('GET',path)[1]['data']['payload']==payload
            for server in (primary,peer):
                final=json.loads(server.encryption_path.read_text())
                serialized=json.dumps(final)
                assert old['secret'] not in serialized and old['name'] not in serialized,'old decryption key was not retired'
            print(json.dumps({'native':'etcd3.6.4+kube-apiserver1.34.1','instances':2,'rolling_cross_reads':True,'storage_rewritten':True,'old_cipher_bytes':len(old_cipher),'phases':audit}))
        finally:peer.close()


def check_rbac():
    target_name='release-editor-'+secrets.token_hex(5)
    target_user='opsforge-pilot-user-'+secrets.token_hex(5)
    desired=load_student().manifests(target_name,target_user)
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        cluster.identity('learner',target_user)
        ns='rbac-'+secrets.token_hex(4);cluster.namespace(ns)
        cluster.identity('manager','opsforge-pilot-manager');cluster.identity('outsider','opsforge-pilot-outsider')
        base=[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'resourceNames':['baseline'],'verbs':['get']}]
        edit=[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'resourceNames':['release'],'verbs':['get','patch','update']}]
        role(cluster,ns,'baseline-view',base,target_user)
        role(cluster,ns,'manager',edit+[{'apiGroups':['rbac.authorization.k8s.io'],'resources':['roles','rolebindings'],'verbs':['get','create']}],'opsforge-pilot-manager')
        for name in ('baseline','release','unrelated'):
            cluster.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':name},'data':{'value':secrets.token_hex(8)}})
        baseline=cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/baseline-view')[1]
        assert cluster.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps/baseline',identity='learner')[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:rbac',flush=True)
        assert isinstance(desired,list) and len(desired)==2
        for obj in desired:
            assert obj.get('kind') in ('Role','RoleBinding')
            obj['metadata']['namespace']=ns
            plural='roles' if obj['kind']=='Role' else 'rolebindings'
            code,result=cluster.request('POST',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/{plural}',obj,identity='manager')
            assert code==201,('delegation rejected by real bind/escalate guard',code,result)
        actual_role=cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/roles/{target_name}')
        actual_binding=cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/{target_name}')
        assert actual_role[0]==actual_binding[0]==200,'must use the supplied dynamic role and binding name'

import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()

    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

                config=step['config']

                if step.get('rewrite'):
                    for _,path,payload in targets:
                        code,obj=primary.request('GET',path);assert code==200

                prefixes=[]

                    raw=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{name}')
                    assert b'k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:' in raw[:32],'plaintext provider cannot be preferred'
                    prefixes.append(raw.split(b':',5)[4].decode())
                audit.append({'phase':index,'objects':len(targets),'key_names':sorted(set(prefixes))})
            for name,path,payload in targets:

answer:
```python
def preview(request, base, good, bad):
    allowed,_=request("POST",base+"?dryRun=All",good)
    denied,_=request("POST",base+"?dryRun=All",bad)
    persisted,_=request("GET",base+"/"+good["metadata"]["name"])
    return {"admitted":allowed==201,"rejected":denied==422,"persisted":persisted==200,"runtime_verified":False}
```

## 原题原理与边界
客户端渲染检查参数和输出结构；kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f 文件会请求 API 的校验及支持 dry-run 的准入路径，但不持久化该对象。真正部署后才能验证调度、镜像、挂载和业务健康。服务端 dry-run 仍需权限并访问集群，且依赖 webhook 正确声明无副作用，不能无条件当作完全离线操作。

平台隔离Linux工作区含kube-apiserver v1.34.1、etcd3.6.4、OpenSSL与Python标准库；固定检查器自建私有mTLS控制面，无网络下载，不读取或改动用户kubeconfig。双实例换钥需至少1536MiB工作区；其余单实例可用768MiB。

solution.py；仅修改该文件，不修改checks。

运行python3 checks/check.py，真实原生API/etcd多分支断言，参考/初始/错误/提前exit0四路线及独立对抗反例，错误方案必须失败。

真实API授权、原生CEL准入与etcd不持久化语义；不覆盖外部webhook网络、副作用声明、调度、拉镜像和业务运行。原题关于webhook边界仍保留，不能因server dry-run成功宣称部署成功。

class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):

        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

import base64
import importlib.util
import json
import pathlib
import secrets
import time
from native import Cluster


def load_student():
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('submission',pathlib.Path('solution.py').resolve())
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def role(cluster, ns, name, rules, user):
    cluster.create('/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/roles',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':name},'rules':rules})
    cluster.create('/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/rolebindings',{'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':name},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'Role','name':name},'subjects':[{'kind':'User','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','name':user}]})


def encryption(keys):
    return {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'aescbc':{'keys':keys}},{'identity':{}}]}]}


def check_rotation():
    old={'name':'old-'+secrets.token_hex(4),'secret':base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode()}
    new={'name':'new-'+secrets.token_hex(4),'secret':base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode()}
    plan=load_student().plan(old.copy(),new.copy())
    assert isinstance(plan,list) and 1<=len(plan)<=5,'provide a bounded rotation plan'
    audit=[]
    with Cluster(encryption([old])) as primary:
        peer=primary.peer(encryption([old]))
        try:
            print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:rotation',flush=True)
            ns='rotation-'+secrets.token_hex(4);primary.namespace(ns)
            targets=[]
            for i in range(3):
                name='secret-'+secrets.token_hex(3);payload=base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(23)).decode()
                path=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{name}'
                primary.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Secret','metadata':{'name':name},'data':{'payload':payload}})
                targets.append((name,path,payload))
            old_cipher=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{targets[0][0]}')
            assert old_cipher.startswith(('k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:'+old['name']+':').encode())
            for index,step in enumerate(plan):
                assert isinstance(step,dict) and type(step.get('rewrite')) is bool,'rewrite must be an explicit boolean'
                config=step['config']
                for server in (primary,peer):
                    server.restart_api(config)
                    # A writer changes as soon as this instance restarts. Every other
                    # instance must already understand what it writes.
                    name='probe-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
                    value=base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(17)).decode()
                    server.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Secret','metadata':{'name':name},'data':{'payload':value}})
                    targets.append((name,f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{name}',value))
                    for reader in (primary,peer):
                        for _,path,payload in targets:
                            code,obj=reader.request('GET',path)
                            assert code==200 and obj['data']['payload']==payload,'cross-instance compatibility failed before/after a rolling update'
                if step.get('rewrite'):
                    for _,path,payload in targets:
                        code,obj=primary.request('GET',path);assert code==200
                        code,_=primary.request('PUT',path,obj);assert code==200
                prefixes=[]
                for name,_,_ in targets:
                    raw=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{name}')
                    assert b'k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:' in raw[:32],'plaintext provider cannot be preferred'
                    prefixes.append(raw.split(b':',5)[4].decode())
                audit.append({'phase':index,'objects':len(targets),'key_names':sorted(set(prefixes))})
            for name,path,payload in targets:
                raw=primary.etcd_value(f'/registry/secrets/{ns}/{name}')
                assert raw.startswith(('k8s:enc:aescbc:v1:'+new['name']+':').encode()),'existing storage was not actually rewritten with new key'
                for server in (primary,peer):
                    assert server.request('GET',path)[1]['data']['payload']==payload
            for server in (primary,peer):
                final=json.loads(server.encryption_path.read_text())
                serialized=json.dumps(final)
                assert old['secret'] not in serialized and old['name'] not in serialized,'old decryption key was not retired'
            print(json.dumps({'native':'etcd3.6.4+kube-apiserver1.34.1','instances':2,'rolling_cross_reads':True,'storage_rewritten':True,'old_cipher_bytes':len(old_cipher),'phases':audit}))
        finally:peer.close()


def check_rbac():
    target_name='release-editor-'+secrets.token_hex(5)
    target_user='opsforge-pilot-user-'+secrets.token_hex(5)
    desired=load_student().manifests(target_name,target_user)
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        cluster.identity('learner',target_user)
        ns='rbac-'+secrets.token_hex(4);cluster.namespace(ns)
        cluster.identity('manager','opsforge-pilot-manager');cluster.identity('outsider','opsforge-pilot-outsider')
        base=[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'resourceNames':['baseline'],'verbs':['get']}]
        edit=[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'resourceNames':['release'],'verbs':['get','patch','update']}]
        role(cluster,ns,'baseline-view',base,target_user)
        role(cluster,ns,'manager',edit+[{'apiGroups':['rbac.authorization.k8s.io'],'resources':['roles','rolebindings'],'verbs':['get','create']}],'opsforge-pilot-manager')
        for name in ('baseline','release','unrelated'):
            cluster.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':name},'data':{'value':secrets.token_hex(8)}})
        baseline=cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/baseline-view')[1]
        assert cluster.request('GET',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps/baseline',identity='learner')[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:rbac',flush=True)
        assert isinstance(desired,list) and len(desired)==2
        for obj in desired:
            assert obj.get('kind') in ('Role','RoleBinding')
            obj['metadata']['namespace']=ns
            plural='roles' if obj['kind']=='Role' else 'rolebindings'
            code,result=cluster.request('POST',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/{plural}',obj,identity='manager')
            assert code==201,('delegation rejected by real bind/escalate guard',code,result)
        actual_role=cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/roles/{target_name}')
        actual_binding=cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/{target_name}')
        assert actual_role[0]==actual_binding[0]==200,'must use the supplied dynamic role and binding name'
        assert actual_binding[1]['roleRef']['name']==target_name
        probes=[]
        def expect(method,path,expected,data=None,identity='learner',ctype='application/json'):
            code,value=cluster.request(method,path,data,identity,ctype);probes.append({'method':method,'path':path,'identity':identity,'status':code})
            assert code==expected,(code,expected,value)
        root=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}'
        expect('GET',root+'/configmaps/baseline',200)
        expect('PATCH',root+'/configmaps/release',200,{'data':{'value':'changed'}},ctype='application/merge-patch+json')
        expect('PATCH',root+'/configmaps/baseline',403,{'data':{'value':'bad'}},ctype='application/merge-patch+json')
        expect('PATCH',root+'/configmaps/unrelated',403,{'data':{'value':'bad'}},ctype='application/merge-patch+json')
        expect('GET',root+'/configmaps',403)
        expect('GET',root+'/secrets',403)
        expect('GET',root+'/configmaps/release',403,identity='outsider')
        bad={'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'Role','metadata':{'name':'escalated'},'rules':[{'apiGroups':['*'],'resources':['*'],'verbs':['*']}]}
        expect('POST',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/roles',403,bad,identity='manager')
        binding={'apiVersion':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1','kind':'RoleBinding','metadata':{'name':'bad-admin'},'roleRef':{'apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','kind':'ClusterRole','name':'cluster-admin'},'subjects':[{'kind':'User','apiGroup':'rbac.authorization.k8s.io','name':target_user}]}
        expect('POST',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings',403,binding,identity='manager')
        assert cluster.request('GET',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/baseline-view')[1]==baseline
        print(json.dumps({'native_rbac':probes,'baseline_unchanged':True}))


def check_node():
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        ns='node-'+secrets.token_hex(4);cluster.namespace(ns)
        own='node-'+secrets.token_hex(3);other='node-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
        cluster.identity('node','system:node:'+own,'system:nodes')
        for name in (own,other):cluster.create('/api/v1/nodes',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Node','metadata':{'name':name}})
        secrets_by_node={}
        for node in (own,other):
            secret='key-'+secrets.token_hex(4);secrets_by_node[node]=secret
            cluster.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Secret','metadata':{'name':secret},'stringData':{'value':secrets.token_hex(8)}})
            cluster.create(f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/pods',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Pod','metadata':{'name':'pod-'+node},'spec':{'nodeName':node,'containers':[{'name':'work','image':'invalid.local/never-pulled','volumeMounts':[{'name':'data','mountPath':'/data'}]}],'volumes':[{'name':'data','secret':{'secretName':secret}}]}})
        paths={'own_secret':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{secrets_by_node[own]}','other_secret':f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/secrets/{secrets_by_node[other]}','own_node':'/api/v1/nodes/'+own,'other_node':'/api/v1/nodes/'+other}
        trace=[]
        def request(method,path,data=None):
            code,obj=cluster.request(method,path,data,identity='node',content_type='application/merge-patch+json' if method=='PATCH' else 'application/json')
            trace.append({'method':method,'path':path,'status':code});return code,obj
        for _ in range(50):
            if cluster.request('GET',paths['own_secret'],identity='node')[0]==200:break
            time.sleep(.1)
        assert cluster.request('GET',paths['own_secret'],identity='node')[0]==200
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:node',flush=True)
        results=load_student().probe(request,paths)
        assert results=={'own_secret':200,'other_secret':403,'own_label':200,'other_node':403,'protected_label':403},results
        expected=[('GET',paths['own_secret'],200),('GET',paths['other_secret'],403),('PATCH',paths['own_node'],200),('PATCH',paths['other_node'],403),('PATCH',paths['own_node'],403)]
        assert [(x['method'],x['path'],x['status']) for x in trace]==expected,'must make and report actual API requests, not fabricate expected statuses'
        own_state=cluster.request('GET',paths['own_node'])[1]
        assert own_state['metadata']['labels'].get('opsforge.example.com/probe')=='checked'
        assert 'node-restriction.kubernetes.io/trusted' not in own_state['metadata'].get('labels',{})
        assert 'opsforge.example.com/probe' not in cluster.request('GET',paths['other_node'])[1]['metadata'].get('labels',{})
        assert request('GET',paths['own_secret'])[0]==200,'original allowed access regressed'
        # RBAC is additive: a separately granted read can bypass the node authorizer's
        # lack of a grant. Verify the leak, then revoke only this dedicated test grant.
        role(cluster,ns,'temporary-leak',[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['secrets'],'verbs':['get']}],'system:node:'+own)
        assert request('GET',paths['other_secret'])[0]==200,'additive RBAC control not exercised'
        assert cluster.request('DELETE',f'/apis/rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/{ns}/rolebindings/temporary-leak',{})[0]==200
        assert request('GET',paths['other_secret'])[0]==403
        assert request('GET',paths['own_secret'])[0]==200
        print(json.dumps({'node_authorizer_and_restriction':trace,'additive_rbac_control':True,'baseline_retained':True}))


def check_dryrun():
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        ns='dryrun-'+secrets.token_hex(4);cluster.namespace(ns)
        role(cluster,ns,'preview',[{'apiGroups':[''],'resources':['configmaps'],'verbs':['get','list','create']}],'opsforge-pilot-user')
        # Real CEL admission policy: no fake HTTP server or local YAML-only validation.
        policy='guard-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        cluster.create('/apis/admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1/validatingadmissionpolicies',{'apiVersion':'admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1','kind':'ValidatingAdmissionPolicy','metadata':{'name':policy},'spec':{'failurePolicy':'Fail','matchConstraints':{'resourceRules':[{'apiGroups':[''],'apiVersions':['v1'],'operations':['CREATE'],'resources':['configmaps']}]},'validations':[{'expression':"!has(object.data) || !('forbidden' in object.data)",'message':'forbidden data is not admitted'}]}})
        cluster.create('/apis/admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1/validatingadmissionpolicybindings',{'apiVersion':'admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1','kind':'ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding','metadata':{'name':policy},'spec':{'policyName':policy,'validationActions':['Deny'],'matchResources':{'namespaceSelector':{'matchLabels':{'kubernetes.io/metadata.name':ns}}}}})
        # Wait for actual admission cache readiness before calling the learner.
        for _ in range(60):
            code,_=cluster.request('POST',f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps?dryRun=All',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'ready-probe'},'data':{'forbidden':'x'}})
            if code==422:break
            time.sleep(.1)
        assert code==422,'real CEL admission never became effective'
        print('NATIVE_FIXTURE_READY:dryrun',flush=True)
        trace=[]
        def request(method,path,data=None):
            code,obj=cluster.request(method,path,data,identity='learner');trace.append({'method':method,'path':path,'status':code});return code,obj
        good={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'good-'+secrets.token_hex(4)},'data':{'value':secrets.token_hex(9)}}
        bad={'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'ConfigMap','metadata':{'name':'bad-'+secrets.token_hex(4)},'data':{'forbidden':'x'}}
        base=f'/api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/configmaps'
        result=load_student().preview(request,base,good,bad)
        assert result=={'admitted':True,'rejected':True,'persisted':False,'runtime_verified':False},result
        assert [(x['method'],x['path'],x['status']) for x in trace]==[('POST',base+'?dryRun=All',201),('POST',base+'?dryRun=All',422),('GET',base+'/'+good['metadata']['name'],404)]
        assert cluster.request('GET',base)[1]['items']==[],'dry-run must not persist any artifact'
        # Server dry-run still needs authorization, even with a syntactically valid object.
        cluster.identity('unauthorized','opsforge-pilot-unauthorized')
        assert cluster.request('POST',base+'?dryRun=All',good,identity='unauthorized')[0]==403
        # A real create of the same allowed document DOES persist: distinguish stages.
        saved=cluster.create(base,good)
        assert saved['metadata']['uid'] and cluster.request('GET',base+'/'+good['metadata']['name'])[0]==200
        print(json.dumps({'dryrun_api_trace':trace,'real_admission':True,'dryrun_persisted':False,'actual_create_persisted':True,'node_runtime_tested':False}))

    {'rotation':check_rotation,'rbac':check_rbac,'node':check_node,'dryrun':check_dryrun}[case]()
